findings: The normalized 88-byte clear digest also differs. The tested optimizations produce different inlining and the public packet entry retained by the driver uses cdecl. The legacy packet entry receives its first two arguments in registers.
The MSVC probes give decoder context sizes of 54032 for 1.1.1 and 57184 for 1.2.0. The legacy initialization extent is 54160.

The public entry uses cdecl stack arguments. The legacy entry takes its first two arguments in registers. Compiling the driver with /GL produces a 425-byte bitreverse helper compared with 423 bytes in the legacy file, and still moves the entry call sites.
The butterflies call sites and absolute constants match. Its legacy hash differs. The legacy normalization includes rel32 displacements, which depend on the linked placement of the helpers.
